id: title:arnohillen:show the startup program cap on vision spend

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend-only display and calculation of startup program credit caps, while backend billing enforcement and configuration are absent.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F14.H1 adds frontend constants and display logic for startup program credit caps. However, the chunk explicitly omits the backend implementation, billing configuration, and API schema changes. Without the server-side enforcement and configuration, this is a narrow, frontend-only change rather than a complete, systemic billing or reliability improvement. P1.F14.H1 alone
